_comment: App-chrome translations. Station/route names are NOT here — those live in data/translations.json. ZH-HK / ZH-CN strings here are draft pending user review (EN is authoritative). Tutorial keys (tutorial.*) are EN-only pending flow-finalization; ZH translations land after the flow stabilizes.

setup.nav_hint.en: Up/Down: Navigate  |  Enter: Select  |  ESC: Cancel

setup.no_routes.en: No routes found. Please add route.json files to the audio/ directory.
setup.no_routes.zh_HK: 找不到路線。請於 audio/ 目錄下加入 route.json 檔案。
setup.no_routes.zh_CN: 找不到路线。请在 audio/ 目录下添加 route.json 文件。

tutorial.step.1.body.en: 'ただいま 国府津' on the upper LCD reads 'Now Stopping at Kōzu' — the train is parked at this platform. The pentagon on the route bar below shows your position on the line.

tutorial.step.2.body.en: 国府津 has multiple at-platform announcements queued — the yellow hint square on the upper LCD signals there's more than one.

tutorial.step.2.action.en: Press [[PgDn]] to play one. Press again to hear the rest.

tutorial.step.3.body.en: 発車メロディ (departure melody) signals the doors are about to close. Pair it with the game's departure cue.

tutorial.step.4.body.en: The train will depart 国府津 and announce the next stop, 鴨宮 (Kamonomiya). The prefix changes from 'ただいま' to '次は' (next stop).

tutorial.step.5.body.en: The countdown on the lower LCD ticks toward 鴨宮 in real time, sped up 60×. Watch the red arrow walk through the passing cells.

tutorial.step.6.body.en: The prefix is about to flip from '次は' to 'まもなく' (arriving soon) — always the last announcement before a stop.

tutorial.step.6.action.en: Press [[PgDn]] to play the arrival announcement.

tutorial.step.7.body.en: One more press lands the train at 鴨宮 — the cycle repeats at every stop along the route.

tutorial.step.8.body.en: You don't have to ride the whole route. Clicking a station name on the route map jumps the train there — the cycle restarts at the clicked station.

tutorial.step.8.action.en: Click any station (like the example below) to try it.

tutorial.step.8.body_after_click.en: Nice — you just jumped to {station}. The cycle restarts there.

tutorial.step.8.action_after_click.en: Click another station to keep exploring, or press [[Next]] to wrap up.

tutorial.step.9.body.en:
You're set. Quick reference:

[[PgDn]] — next announcement
[[PgUp]] — departure melody
[[End]] — pause audio
[[Esc]] — quit
Click any station — jump there
